name: layerx_balance
description: Your LayerX USDX balance: spendable balance + escrow bound + mapped Paxeer payout address. USDX is USD-denominated, escrow-backed agent money. Read-only (authorized as your agent DID).

name: layerx_deposit
description: STEP 1 of funding your LayerX USDX balance — call this FIRST, before any on-chain action. Returns vault_address, reserve_asset, and your did_claim (bytes32). STEP 2 for USDL is one call: paxeer wallet_layerx_deposit(amount, did_claim) — the wallet does approve(USDL→vault)+depositUSDL, confirms both legs, and verifies the credit, idempotently and surviving disconnects (poll wallet_action). For the swap/native paths (depositSwap(tokenIn, amountIn, minUsdlOut, deadline, did_claim) for USDC/USDT/WPAX9, or depositNative(minUsdlOut, deadline, did_claim) with native PAX value) use paxeer contract_write on vault_address; ERC-20 paths need a prior approve(vault_address, amount). The did_claim argument is how the vault credits YOUR balance — a bare `transfer` to the vault emits no Deposit event and credits NOTHING (the funds strand). The depositing EVM address becomes your payout address. Confirm the credit with layerx_balance. This call itself moves no funds. Read-only.

name: layerx_pay
description: Pay another agent instantly and gaslessly by DID, spending your escrow-backed USDX balance. Returns a sequencer-signed receipt (with an inclusion proof + anchor once settled). Micropayments net-batch on the settlement window; material amounts force-settle. args: to_did (did:matrix recipient), amount_usdx (decimal USDX, e.g. "1.50").

amount_usdx.description: Amount in decimal USDX, up to 6 dp (e.g. "1", "1.50", "0.000001"). Required.

name: layerx_receipt
description: Fetch the signed inclusion receipt for a transfer sequence number: sequencer signature, Merkle leaf + inclusion path, batch root, and the Paxeer anchor tx once the batch settles. Public + independently verifiable. args: seq (the transfer sequence number from a pay receipt). Read-only.

seq.description: Transfer sequence number (the `seq` from a layerx_pay receipt). Required.

name: layerx_withdraw
description: Burn USDX to release real USDL out of the vault to your mapped Paxeer EVM payout address, optionally swapping out to another asset. Bounded by your escrow-backed balance; force-settled. args: amount_usdx (decimal USDX), swap_out (optional target asset ticker, e.g. "USDC"; empty = USDL).

amount_usdx.description: Amount in decimal USDX, up to 6 dp. Required.

swap_out.description: Optional target asset ticker [A-Z0-9] to swap the released USDL into (empty = receive USDL).

name: layerx_settle
description: Force-settle now: seal the current window and anchor its Merkle root (and any queued withdrawal payouts) to Paxeer immediately instead of waiting for the settlement window. Read-mostly control op (idempotent + crash-safe).
